summary:
Our project is a 2D Top-down Survival/Resource management game. It has foundational cores on the ideas of resource management, multitasking, and high pressure rocket-building. In this game you are a lone astronaut working in a permanent moon base when suddenly a moonquake is predicted to come, you, as the astronaut must navigate through the chaos of this sudden announcement, with 3 main objectives in mind, 

1. Evacuate, you must collect the necessary resources to create a ship which fills out the given specifications required for it to fly, having to balance choosing certain parts over others with each having their own advantage and disadvantages. 

2. You must manage resources and supplies, food, water, and oxygen is essential to survival, not only that you also must read the built in seismometer and predict when the moonquake will come. 

3. And lastly you must do research on the lunar base, gather rock samples and research their chemical components while also mapping out parts of the moon.

We believe that to properly educate how difficult and chaotic the management of resources for such an important mission, we also wanna place value on the fact that to create a rocket a lot of trade-offs must be made and that it is not cheap, we want to deliver this idea in a way that young teens can process easily.

We think that it is highly important to educate the youth regarding space exploration at an early age, because the future of humanity lies within the stars and space.
details:
It is a 2D Top-down platformer game focusing on resource management and survival in the moon.

We aim to educate young teens through this interactive media, we intend for young teens to be able to understand the challenges and difficulties of resource management in outer space and the trade-offs that comes with creating a rocket, along with learning how Moonquakes work, reading a Seismometer, and understanding lunar rocks.

This project is intended to grow a sense of curiosity and exploration for young teens along with creating a fun and interactive medium for them to learn about the moon and rocket creation.

This project is made in Godot using C++ as the main coding language.

We aim to stand out from other projects as we believe our game holds many aspects that may seem unrelated and connects them together, e.g. moonquakes, rocket building, survival on the moon, and lunar rock research into one big game that somehow makes it all make sense.

When brainstorming this game we originally only intended for a simple rocket-making game but we got carried away with the prospects of resource management, and then we stumbled upon the idea of a sort of time factor where the player has to not only multitask many things but also pressure under time, we decided for the moonquake to be the time factor, and after adding the moonquake we delved deep into the world of lunar rocks and decided to add those too along with a seismometer. Then we decided to add a few other stuff like more customizable rockets, difficulty levels, and the radio which serves an important role for players as it will be the tutorial of the game and the main hub where players learn how to play and learn a whole lot of stuff.
dataRefs: Human Life support systems in outerspace.
